plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Harness — a lightweight reasoning floor. Pass a raw request; a fixed six-stage engine runs Plan(opus) → SetGoal(opus, adversarial critic) → Implement(provider-routed, Codex when enabled) → Test(provider-routed, Codex when enabled) → QualityGate(opus, bounded loop + goal-level gate) → Report(sonnet). Filters repetition and below-threshold answers regardless of main-session model. B (request + engine) default; A (bespoke Workflow) for custom control flow. Enforcement: opt-in PreToolUse gate — projects list gated paths in .claude/harness-gate.json; edits there require harness engagement (fail-open). The install skill scaffolds a project: it embeds the self-contained gate hook (copies goal-gate.mjs into .claude/hooks/ and merges a PreToolUse entry into committed .claude/settings.json), plus gate config, default conventions (coding/verification/boundaries), and an ambient CLAUDE.md section — project-owned copies, never overwritten. It also optionally embeds the engine + Codex CLI adapter/runner + statically-referenced skills into .claude/harness/ for plugin-less environments (opt-in; dynamic subgoal skills[] cannot be pre-enumerated). Mode M: for control flow the fixed stages cannot express, the harness generates a bespoke Workflow from templates/meta-skeleton.js (contract preserved: judge≠actor, provider routing, bounded loops, deterministic Test, goal-level gate). Workflow path: when codex_provider is auto or required, every Implement/Test stage uses a minimal Sonnet controller to resolve engine/codex-exec-adapter.mjs and delegate to a separate local codex exec --json process; implement_provider/test_provider codex are optional trace hints, not routing prerequisites. On Codex success the controller only converts Codex output into the normal HANDOFF/evidence shape; it does not redo implementation or verification. codex_provider=auto allows explicit degraded Sonnet fallback; codex_provider=required reports provider failure instead of silently falling back. DW-off/Workflow-less fallback (engine/fallback.md): when Dynamic Workflow is disabled or the Workflow tool is absent, the orchestrator first forms a role-isolated Agent Team; the thin team lead coordinates Plan, SetGoal/Critic, Implement, Test, QualityGate, and Report teammates through files in a run directory, closed by fallback-check.mjs. Provider delegation is off by default (codex_provider defaults to off): both the Workflow and fallback paths run Implement/Test on Claude unless a run opts in with codex_provider auto or required. Active Codex sessions should follow AGENTS.md and run the harness contract directly with native tools, not recurse through codex, codex-exec-adapter.mjs, or codex-runner.mjs. SetGoal may also optionally map the repo harness-aware dual-mode skills (writing-plans, executing-plans, subagent-driven-development, test-driven-development, etc.) as subgoal executors; none is required.

plugins.name: graph
plugins.description: Graph engineering for the harness flow: a local MCP server owns graph state, routes nodes to vendor CLIs or the session, adjudicates results against the worktree, and keeps payloads on disk. Includes graph:install and graph:orchestrate.
